content: Bad times have a scientific value. These are occasions a good learner would not miss.
author: Ralph Waldo Emerson
explanation: Ease and prosperity rarely reveal the deeper mechanics of character. Periods of hardship and scarcity strip away illusion and force profound self-knowledge.
practicalInsight: Treat your current hardship not as a punishment, but as an advanced masterclass in resilience and clarity.
reflectionPrompt: What essential lesson is your current difficulty attempting to teach you?
